The structure of Rb12Sc4Cl24 (reduced formula Rb3ScCl6) is cubic, space group F-43m (No. 216), with 40 atoms in the unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Sc centers in octahedral Cl coordination (6 neighbors, 2.486 Å), while Rb centers have 8 Cl neighbors at 3.4504–3.523 Å; the geometric neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include edge-sharing between Sc octahedra and corner-sharing between Sc octahedra and Rb 8-vertex polyhedra.
